decls.name: xi_catalogue
decls.statement:
def xi_catalogue : ExhaustiveCatalogue ℂ OffLineOrNonSimple :=
  { classes := voice_classes
    covers_all := by
      intro s hs
      obtain ⟨hz, hlo, hhi, h_bad⟩ := hs
      rcases h_bad with h_off | h_deriv
      -- Case 1: off-line zero. C1 produces it.
      · exact ⟨C1, List.Mem.head _, h_off⟩
      -- Case 2: deriv = 0 on the line. Need s.re = 1/2.
      · by_cases h12 : s.re = 1 / 2
        · exact ⟨C_simple, List.Mem.tail _ (List.Mem.tail _ (List.Mem.head _)),
            ⟨h12, h_deriv⟩⟩
        · exact ⟨C1, List.Mem.head _, h12⟩ }

  | C3_cauchy_riemann   -- from output (local holomorphic structure)
  | C4_euler_product    -- from primitive (multiplicative group of Z)
  | C5_modular          -- from transformation (global/PSL2Z)

  | MechClass.C4_euler_product   => Stage.primitive
  | MechClass.C5_modular         => Stage.transformation
  | MechClass.C6_spectral        => Stage.transformation
  | MechClass.C7_topological     => Stage.output

  /-- The target property to exclude -/
  target : Prop
  /-- For each domain element: does it produce the target? -/
  produces : Domain → Prop
  /-- Every element is accounted for (the domain is finite/enumerable) -/
  exhaustive : ∀ d : Domain, d = d  -- tautological here; in practice, the finite type guarantees this
  /-- No element produces the target -/
  none_produces : ∀ d : Domain, ¬(produces d)
  /-- Therefore: target does not hold -/
  exclusion : ¬target

decls.name: responseSet
decls.statement:
noncomputable def responseSet
    {A B : Type*} [Fintype A]
    (P : B -> Real) (f : A -> B) (a0 : A) : Finset Real :=
  Finset.univ.image (fun a => |P (f a) - P (f a0)|)

decls.name: kappa
decls.statement:

    {A B : Type*} [Fintype A]
    (P : B -> Real) (f : A -> B) (a0 : A) : Real :=
  (responseSet P f a0).max' (by
    refine Finset.image_nonempty.mpr ?_
    exact ⟨a0, Finset.mem_univ a0⟩)

decls.name: kappa_invariance

  1 - kappa P f a0

decls.name: StructuralCoupling
decls.statement:
inductive StructuralCoupling : Type where
  | residue (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (a : ZMod q) : StructuralCoupling
  | divisible (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) : StructuralCoupling
  | coprime (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) : StructuralCoupling
  | conjunction (left right : StructuralCoupling) : StructuralCoupling
  | disjunction (left right : StructuralCoupling) : StructuralCoupling
  | shifted (k : ℕ) (inner : StructuralCoupling) : StructuralCoupling
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: StructuralCoupling.eval
decls.statement:
def StructuralCoupling.eval : StructuralCoupling → ℕ → Prop
  | .residue q _ a, n => (n : ZMod q) = a
  | .divisible q _, n => q ∣ n
  | .coprime m _, n => Nat.gcd n m = 1
  | .conjunction l r, n => l.eval n ∧ r.eval n
  | .disjunction l r, n => l.eval n ∨ r.eval n
  | .shifted k inner, n => inner.eval (n + k)
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: ModularCoupling
decls.statement:
structure ModularCoupling : Type where
  moduli : Finset ℕ
  allowed_residues : (q : ℕ) → q ∈ moduli → Finset (ZMod q)
decls.subject: ARITHMETIC-OR-LOGIC

decls.name: ModularCoupling.eval
decls.statement:
def ModularCoupling.eval (m : ModularCoupling) (n : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ q, ∀ h : q ∈ m.moduli, (n : ZMod q) ∈ m.allowed_residues q h
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: StructuralCoupling.period
decls.statement:
def StructuralCoupling.period : StructuralCoupling → ℕ
  | .residue q _ _ => q
  | .divisible q _ => q
  | .coprime m _ => m
  | .conjunction l r => Nat.lcm l.period r.period
  | .disjunction l r => Nat.lcm l.period r.period
  | .shifted _ inner => inner.period
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: ofPeriodic
decls.statement:
noncomputable def ofPeriodic (L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) (P : ℕ → Prop) :
    ModularCoupling where
  moduli := {L}
  allowed_residues := fun q hq =>
    haveI : NeZero q := ⟨by rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at hq; subst hq; exact hL.ne'⟩
    haveI : DecidablePred (fun r : ZMod q => P r.val) := Classical.decPred _
    Finset.univ.filter (fun r : ZMod q => P r.val)

    (ofPeriodic L hL P).eval n ↔ P n :=

    (fun s => !(s % ballQ p n == 0)
              && !((t * s) % gridN p n % ballQ p n == 0)
              && ((t - 1) * s) % m == 0)).length

decls.name: signed_count_at_the_identity_is_the_dimension
decls.statement:
theorem signed_count_at_the_identity_is_the_dimension :
    (cells.all (fun c =>
      let p := c.1; let n := c.2
      let q := ballQ p n
      let aN := offBallFixed p n 1 (gridN p n)
      let aQ := offBallFixed p n 1 q
      (aN == aQ) && (q * aN - aQ == q * (p ^ n - 1) * (p ^ n - 1)))) = true :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: identity_term_survives_alone

      let p := c.1; let n := c.2.1; let j := c.2.2
      let q := ballQ p n
      (offBallFixed p n (p ^ j) (gridN p n) == 0)
      && (offBallFixed p n (p ^ j) q == 0)
      && !(offBallFixed p n 1 (gridN p n) == 0)
      && !(offBallFixed p n 1 q == 0))) = true :=

decls.name: stdAddChar
decls.statement:
noncomputable def stdAddChar : AddChar ℚ_[p] Circle where
  toFun x := Circle.exp (2 * Real.pi * (padicFract p x : ℝ))
  map_zero_eq_one' := by
    have h0 : padicFract p 0 = 0 :=
      padicFract_eq_zero_of_norm_le_one p 0 (by simp)
    simp [h0]
  map_add_eq_mul' := by
    intro x y
    show Circle.exp (2 * Real.pi * (padicFract p (x + y) : ℝ)) =
      Circle.exp (2 * Real.pi * (padicFract p x : ℝ)) *
        Circle.exp (2 * Real.pi * (padicFract p y : ℝ))
    rw [← Circle.exp_add, Circle.exp_eq_exp]
    obtain ⟨a₁, k₁, h₁⟩ := padicFract_denpow p (x + y)
    obtain ⟨a₂, k₂, h₂⟩ := padicFract_denpow p x
    obtain ⟨a₃, k₃, h₃⟩ := padicFract_denpow p y
    have hp0Q : (p : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
      exact_mod_cast (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_zero
    set d : ℚ := padicFract p (x + y) - padicFract p x - padicFract p y with hdd
    have hA : d = ((a₁ * p ^ (k₂ + k₃) - a₂ * p ^ (k₁ + k₃) - a₃ * p ^ (k₁ + k₂) : ℤ) : ℚ) /
        (p : ℚ) ^ (k₁ + k₂ + k₃) := by
      rw [hdd, h₁, h₂, h₃]
      push_cast
      field_simp
      ring
    have tri : ∀ (u v : ℚ_[p]), ‖u‖ ≤ 1 → ‖v‖ ≤ 1 → ‖u + v‖ ≤ 1 := fun u v hu hv =>
      le_trans (Padic.nonarchimedean u v) (max_le hu hv)
    have hnorm : ‖((d : ℚ) : ℚ_[p])‖ ≤ 1 := by
      have e : ((d : ℚ) : ℚ_[p]) =
          ((x - ((padicFract p x : ℚ) : ℚ_[p])) + (y - ((padicFract p y : ℚ) : ℚ_[p]))) +
            (-((x + y) - ((padicFract p (x + y) : ℚ) : ℚ_[p]))) := by
        rw [hdd]
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [e]
      apply tri
      · exact tri _ _ (padicFract_spec p x) (padicFract_spec p y)
      · rw [norm_neg]
        exact padicFract_spec p (x + y)
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := int_of_denpow_of_norm_le_one p d _ _ hA hnorm
    refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
    have hreal : (padicFract p (x + y) : ℝ) =
        (padicFract p x : ℝ) + (padicFract p y : ℝ) + (n : ℝ) := by
      have hq : padicFract p (x + y) = padicFract p x + padicFract p y + (n : ℚ) := by
        rw [hdd] at hn
        linarith
      exact_mod_cast hq
    rw [hreal]
    ring
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.statement: def pairConst : ℝ := 2
decls.subject: ARITHMETIC-OR-LOGIC

decls.name: cross_bound
decls.statement:
theorem cross_bound (N ε : ℝ) (G : ℂ) (hN : 0 ≤ N) (hG : ‖G‖ ≤ ε * N) :
    ‖2 * (N : ℂ) * G + G ^ 2‖ ≤ (2 * ε + ε ^ 2) * N ^ 2 :=
decls.subject: ARITHMETIC-OR-LOGIC

decls.name: weight_norm_plus
decls.statement: theorem weight_norm_plus (γ₀ δ : ℝ) : ‖((δ : ℂ) ^ 2 + 2 * I * γ₀ * δ) ^ 2‖ = δ ^ 4 + 4 * γ₀ ^ 2 * δ ^ 2 :=
decls.subject: ARITHMETIC-OR-LOGIC

decls.name: weight_norm_minus
decls.statement: theorem weight_norm_minus (γ₀ δ : ℝ) : ‖((δ : ℂ) ^ 2 - 2 * I * γ₀ * δ) ^ 2‖ = δ ^ 4 + 4 * γ₀ ^ 2 * δ ^ 2 :=
decls.subject: ARITHMETIC-OR-LOGIC

decls.name: pair_algebra
decls.statement:
theorem pair_algebra (γ δ ε N S : ℝ) (F sl : ℂ) (hγ : 0 < γ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hS : 0 < S) (hSN : S ≤ N)
    (hF : ‖F‖ ≤ ε * N) (hsl : ‖sl‖ ≤ γ * (1 + ε) * S) (hc : pairEps ε δ γ ≤ pairConst) :
    ((((δ : ℂ) ^ 2 + 2 * I * γ * δ) * ((N : ℂ) + F) / 2) ^ 2 +
      (((δ : ℂ) ^ 2 - 2 * I * γ * δ) * ((N : ℂ) + conj F) / 2) ^ 2).re ≤
      -(pairConst - pairEps ε δ γ) * δ ^ 2 * ‖sl‖ ^ 2 * (N / S) ^ 2 :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: windowSlope_bound
decls.statement:
theorem windowSlope_bound (γ₀ ε : ℝ) {φ : ℝ → ℝ} (hc : Continuous φ) (hs : HasCompactSupport φ)
    (hγ : 0 < γ₀) (hS : 0 ≤ ∫ u, φ u) (hfar0 : farSmall γ₀ φ 0 ε) :
    ‖windowSlope γ₀ φ‖ ≤ γ₀ * (1 + ε) * ∫ u, φ u :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: pair_bound
decls.statement:
theorem pair_bound (γ₀ δ ε : ℝ) {φ : ℝ → ℝ} (hφ : ContDiff ℝ 4 φ) (hφs : HasCompactSupport φ)
    (hev : ∀ x, φ (-x) = φ x) (hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x) (hpos : 0 < ∫ u, φ u)
    (hγ : 0 < γ₀) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hfar : farSmall γ₀ φ δ ε) (hfar0 : farSmall γ₀ φ 0 ε) (hc : pairEps ε δ γ₀ ≤ pairConst) :
    (pairTwo γ₀ φ δ).re ≤
      -(pairConst - pairEps ε δ γ₀) * δ ^ 2 * ‖windowSlope γ₀ φ‖ ^ 2 * realizedGrowth φ δ ^ 2 :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: paperFT_conj_of_real
decls.statement:
theorem paperFT_conj_of_real (g : ℝ → ℝ) (z : ℂ) :
    conj (Zeta23.paperFT (phiC g) (conj z)) = Zeta23.paperFT (phiC g) (-z) :=
decls.subject: ZETA

decls.name: paperFT_neg_of_even
decls.statement:
theorem paperFT_neg_of_even {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hev : ∀ x, g (-x) = g x) (z : ℂ) :
    Zeta23.paperFT (phiC g) (-z) = Zeta23.paperFT (phiC g) z :=
decls.subject: ZETA

decls.name: zero_term_real
decls.statement:
theorem zero_term_real {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hc : Continuous g) (hs : HasCompactSupport g) (z : ℂ) :
    Zeta23.paperFT (Zeta23.EF.weilTest (phiC g) (phiC g)) z =
      Zeta23.paperFT (phiC g) z * Zeta23.paperFT (phiC g) (-z) :=
decls.subject: ZETA

decls.name: polyOpFull
decls.statement:
def polyOpFull (a : List ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ) : ℝ → ℝ :=
  fun u => ∑ p ∈ Finset.range a.length, polyCoef a p * iteratedDeriv p g u
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: polyEvalFull
decls.statement: def polyEvalFull (a : List ℝ) (w : ℂ) : ℂ := ∑ p ∈ Finset.range a.length, (polyCoef a p : ℂ) * w ^ p
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: paperFT_polyOpFull
decls.statement:
theorem paperFT_polyOpFull (a : List ℝ) {g : ℝ → ℝ} {L : ℝ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ a.length g)
    (hs : Function.support g ⊆ Set.Icc (-L) L) (z : ℂ) :
    Zeta23.paperFT (phiC (polyOpFull a g)) z = polyEvalFull a (-(I * z)) * Zeta23.paperFT (phiC g) z :=
decls.subject: ZETA

decls.name: polyOpFull_support
decls.statement:
theorem polyOpFull_support (a : List ℝ) {g : ℝ → ℝ} {L : ℝ} (hs : Function.support g ⊆ Set.Icc (-L) L) :
    Function.support (polyOpFull a g) ⊆ Set.Icc (-L) L :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: polyOpFull_contDiff
decls.statement:
theorem polyOpFull_contDiff (a : List ℝ) {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) g) :
    ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) (polyOpFull a g) :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: pwWindow
decls.statement: def pwWindow (a : List ℝ) (g0 : ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) : ℝ → ℝ := polyOpFull a (power g0 j)
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: kWindow
decls.statement:
def kWindow (a : List ℝ) (g0 : ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) : ℝ → ℂ :=
  Zeta23.EF.weilTest (phiC (pwWindow a g0 j)) (phiC (pwWindow a g0 j))
decls.subject: ZETA

decls.name: pwWindow_contDiff
decls.statement:
theorem pwWindow_contDiff (a : List ℝ) {g0 : ℝ → ℝ} {L : ℝ} (hsm : ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) g0)
    (hs : Function.support g0 ⊆ Set.Icc (-L) L) (j : ℕ) :
    ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) (pwWindow a g0 j) :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: pwWindow_support
decls.statement:
theorem pwWindow_support (a : List ℝ) {g0 : ℝ → ℝ} {L : ℝ} (hs : Function.support g0 ⊆ Set.Icc (-L) L) (j : ℕ) :
    Function.support (pwWindow a g0 j) ⊆ Set.Icc (-(2 ^ j * L)) (2 ^ j * L) :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: kWindow_classK
decls.statement:
theorem kWindow_classK (a : List ℝ) {g0 : ℝ → ℝ} {L : ℝ} (hsm : ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) g0)
    (hs : Function.support g0 ⊆ Set.Icc (-L) L) (j : ℕ) : classK (kWindow a g0 j) :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: kWindow_term
decls.statement:
theorem kWindow_term (a : List ℝ) {g0 : ℝ → ℝ} {L : ℝ} (hev : ∀ x, g0 (-x) = g0 x)
    (hsm : ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) g0) (hs : Function.support g0 ⊆ Set.Icc (-L) L) (j : ℕ) (z : ℂ) :
    Zeta23.paperFT (kWindow a g0 j) z =
      polyEvalFull a (-(I * z)) * polyEvalFull a (I * z) * (Zeta23.paperFT (phiC g0) z) ^ (2 ^ (j + 1)) :=
decls.subject: ZETA

decls.name: vOf
decls.statement: def vOf (ρ : ℂ) : ℂ := (ρ - 1 / 2) ^ 2
decls.subject: ARITHMETIC-OR-LOGIC

decls.name: wOf
decls.statement: def wOf (ρ : ℂ) : ℂ := -(I * Zeta23.gammaOf ρ)
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: wOf_eq
decls.statement: theorem wOf_eq (ρ : ℂ) : wOf ρ = -(ρ - 1 / 2) :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: wOf_sq
decls.statement: theorem wOf_sq (ρ : ℂ) : wOf ρ ^ 2 = vOf ρ :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: norm_wOf
decls.statement: theorem norm_wOf (ρ : ℂ) : ‖wOf ρ‖ = ‖Zeta23.gammaOf ρ‖ :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: gammaOf_sq
decls.statement: theorem gammaOf_sq (ρ : ℂ) : Zeta23.gammaOf ρ ^ 2 = -vOf ρ :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: vOf_re
decls.statement: theorem vOf_re (ρ : ℂ) : (vOf ρ).re = (ρ.re - 1 / 2) ^ 2 - ρ.im ^ 2 :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: vOf_im
decls.statement: theorem vOf_im (ρ : ℂ) : (vOf ρ).im = 2 * (ρ.re - 1 / 2) * ρ.im :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: v_eq_iff
decls.statement: theorem v_eq_iff (ρ ρ' : ℂ) (h : vOf ρ = vOf ρ') : ρ' = ρ ∨ ρ' = 1 - ρ :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: nodes_distinct
decls.statement:
theorem nodes_distinct (Z : Zeta23.ZeroConfig) (g : ℝ → ℝ) (M : ℝ) :
    ∀ ρ ∈ tieSet Z g M, ∀ ρ' ∈ tieSet Z g M, vOf ρ = vOf ρ' → ρ' = ρ ∨ ρ' = 1 - ρ :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: reflect_re
decls.statement: theorem reflect_re (ρ : ℂ) : (Zeta23.reflect ρ).re = 1 - ρ.re :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: reflect_im
decls.statement: theorem reflect_im (ρ : ℂ) : (Zeta23.reflect ρ).im = ρ.im :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: gammaOf_reflect
decls.statement: theorem gammaOf_reflect (ρ : ℂ) : Zeta23.gammaOf (Zeta23.reflect ρ) = conj (Zeta23.gammaOf ρ) :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: vOf_reflect
decls.statement: theorem vOf_reflect (ρ : ℂ) : vOf (Zeta23.reflect ρ) = conj (vOf ρ) :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: paperFT_conj_eq
decls.statement:
theorem paperFT_conj_eq {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hev : ∀ x, g (-x) = g x) (z : ℂ) :
    Zeta23.paperFT (phiC g) (conj z) = conj (Zeta23.paperFT (phiC g) z) :=
decls.subject: ZETA

decls.name: offScore_reflect
decls.statement:
theorem offScore_reflect {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hev : ∀ x, g (-x) = g x) (ρ : ℂ) :
    offScore g (Zeta23.reflect ρ) = offScore g ρ :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: paperFT_of_sq_eq
decls.statement:
theorem paperFT_of_sq_eq {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hev : ∀ x, g (-x) = g x) {z z' : ℂ} (h : z' ^ 2 = z ^ 2) :
    Zeta23.paperFT (phiC g) z' = Zeta23.paperFT (phiC g) z :=
decls.subject: ZETA

decls.name: tie_reflect
decls.statement:
theorem tie_reflect (Z : Zeta23.ZeroConfig) {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hev : ∀ x, g (-x) = g x) {M : ℝ} {ρ : ℂ}
    (h : ρ ∈ tieSet Z g M) : Zeta23.reflect ρ ∈ tieSet Z g M :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: PWSetup
decls.statement:
structure PWSetup (Z : Zeta23.ZeroConfig) (g0 : ℝ → ℝ) (L M : ℝ) : Prop where
  hev : ∀ x, g0 (-x) = g0 x
  hsm : ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) g0
  hs : Function.support g0 ⊆ Set.Icc (-L) L
  hL : 0 ≤ L
  hM : 0 < M
  hdom : ∀ ρ ∈ Z.carrier, ρ.re ≠ 1 / 2 → offScore g0 ρ ≤ M
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: PWSetup.c4
decls.statement: theorem PWSetup.c4 (H : PWSetup Z g0 L M) : ContDiff ℝ 4 g0 :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: PWSetup.tfin
decls.statement: theorem PWSetup.tfin (H : PWSetup Z g0 L M) : (tieSet Z g0 M).Finite :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: PWSetup.kfin
decls.statement: theorem PWSetup.kfin (H : PWSetup Z g0 L M) : (killSet Z g0 M).Finite :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: TF
decls.statement: def TF (H : PWSetup Z g0 L M) : Finset ℂ := H.tfin.toFinset
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: KF
decls.statement: def KF (H : PWSetup Z g0 L M) : Finset ℂ := H.kfin.toFinset
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: Xr
decls.statement: def Xr (H : PWSetup Z g0 L M) : Finset ℝ := (KF H).image (fun ρ => (vOf ρ).re)
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: Kp
decls.statement: def Kp (H : PWSetup Z g0 L M) : Polynomial ℝ := ∏ x ∈ Xr H, (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C x)
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: cE
decls.statement: def cE (H : PWSetup Z g0 L M) : ℝ := 1 + ∑ ρ ∈ TF H, 1 / |ρ.re - 1 / 2|
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: Ep
decls.statement: def Ep (H : PWSetup Z g0 L M) : Polynomial ℝ := 1 + Polynomial.C (cE H) * Polynomial.X
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: VF
decls.statement: def VF (H : PWSetup Z g0 L M) : Finset ℂ := (TF H).image vOf
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: mem_TF
decls.statement: theorem mem_TF (H : PWSetup Z g0 L M) {ρ : ℂ} : ρ ∈ TF H ↔ ρ ∈ tieSet Z g0 M :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: mem_KF
decls.statement: theorem mem_KF (H : PWSetup Z g0 L M) {ρ : ℂ} : ρ ∈ KF H ↔ ρ ∈ killSet Z g0 M :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: cE_pos
decls.statement: theorem cE_pos (H : PWSetup Z g0 L M) : 0 < cE H :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: cE_big
decls.statement: theorem cE_big (H : PWSetup Z g0 L M) {ρ : ℂ} (hρ : ρ ∈ tieSet Z g0 M) : 1 < cE H * |ρ.re - 1 / 2| :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: aeval_real
decls.statement: theorem aeval_real (Q : Polynomial ℝ) (x : ℝ) : Polynomial.aeval (x : ℂ) Q = ((Q.eval x : ℝ) : ℂ) :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: aeval_conj
decls.statement: theorem aeval_conj (Q : Polynomial ℝ) (x : ℂ) : Polynomial.aeval (conj x) Q = conj (Polynomial.aeval x Q) :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: aeval_X_sq_comp
decls.statement:
theorem aeval_X_sq_comp (Q : Polynomial ℝ) (w : ℂ) :
    Polynomial.aeval w (Q.comp (Polynomial.X ^ 2)) = Polynomial.aeval (w ^ 2) Q :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: Pof
decls.statement:
def Pof (H : PWSetup Z g0 L M) (Q : Polynomial ℝ) : Polynomial ℝ :=
  Q.comp (Polynomial.X ^ 2) * (Kp H).comp (Polynomial.X ^ 2) * Ep H
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: aeval_Ep
decls.statement: theorem aeval_Ep (H : PWSetup Z g0 L M) (w : ℂ) : Polynomial.aeval w (Ep H) = 1 + (cE H : ℂ) * w :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: Ep_prod
decls.statement:
theorem Ep_prod (H : PWSetup Z g0 L M) (w : ℂ) :
    Polynomial.aeval w (Ep H) * Polynomial.aeval (-w) (Ep H) = 1 - (cE H : ℂ) ^ 2 * w ^ 2 :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: Pof_eval
decls.statement:
theorem Pof_eval (H : PWSetup Z g0 L M) (Q : Polynomial ℝ) (w : ℂ) :
    Polynomial.aeval w (Pof H Q) =
      Polynomial.aeval (w ^ 2) Q * Polynomial.aeval (w ^ 2) (Kp H) * Polynomial.aeval w (Ep H) :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: Pof_prod
decls.statement:
theorem Pof_prod (H : PWSetup Z g0 L M) (Q : Polynomial ℝ) (w : ℂ) :
    Polynomial.aeval w (Pof H Q) * Polynomial.aeval (-w) (Pof H Q) =
      (Polynomial.aeval (w ^ 2) Q) ^ 2 * (Polynomial.aeval (w ^ 2) (Kp H)) ^ 2 * (1 - (cE H : ℂ) ^ 2 * w ^ 2) :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: coeffList
decls.statement: def coeffList (P : Polynomial ℝ) : List ℝ := (List.range (P.natDegree + 1)).map P.coeff
decls.subject: ARITHMETIC-OR-LOGIC

decls.name: polyEvalFull_coeffList
decls.statement:
theorem polyEvalFull_coeffList (P : Polynomial ℝ) (w : ℂ) :
    polyEvalFull (coeffList P) w = Polynomial.aeval w P :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: vOf_real_of_on
decls.statement: theorem vOf_real_of_on (ρ : ℂ) (h : ρ.re = 1 / 2) : (((vOf ρ).re : ℝ) : ℂ) = vOf ρ :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: Kp_kill
decls.statement:
theorem Kp_kill (H : PWSetup Z g0 L M) {ρ : ℂ} (hρ : ρ ∈ killSet Z g0 M) :
    Polynomial.aeval (vOf ρ) (Kp H) = 0 :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: Kp_tie_ne
decls.statement:
theorem Kp_tie_ne (H : PWSetup Z g0 L M) {ρ : ℂ} (hρ : ρ ∈ tieSet Z g0 M) :
    Polynomial.aeval (vOf ρ) (Kp H) ≠ 0 :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: Efac_ne
decls.statement: theorem Efac_ne (H : PWSetup Z g0 L M) {ρ : ℂ} (hρ : ρ ∈ tieSet Z g0 M) : (1 - (cE H : ℂ) ^ 2 * vOf ρ) ≠ 0 :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: gHat_ne
decls.statement:
theorem gHat_ne (H : PWSetup Z g0 L M) {ρ : ℂ} (hρ : ρ ∈ tieSet Z g0 M) :
    Zeta23.paperFT (phiC g0) (Zeta23.gammaOf ρ) ≠ 0 :=
decls.subject: ZETA

decls.name: Xval
decls.subject: ZETA

decls.name: Xval_ne
decls.statement: theorem Xval_ne (H : PWSetup Z g0 L M) (j : ℕ) {ρ : ℂ} (hρ : ρ ∈ tieSet Z g0 M) : Xval H j ρ ≠ 0 :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: Nf
decls.statement: def Nf (H : PWSetup Z g0 L M) (ρ : ℂ) : ℝ := ‖(Polynomial.aeval (vOf ρ) (Kp H)) ^ 2 * (1 - (cE H : ℂ) ^ 2 * vOf ρ)‖
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: Xval_norm
decls.statement:
theorem Xval_norm (H : PWSetup Z g0 L M) (j : ℕ) {ρ : ℂ} (hρ : ρ ∈ tieSet Z g0 M) :
    ‖Xval H j ρ‖ = Nf H ρ * M ^ (2 ^ (j + 1)) :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: Nf_pos
decls.statement: theorem Nf_pos (H : PWSetup Z g0 L M) {ρ : ℂ} (hρ : ρ ∈ tieSet Z g0 M) : 0 < Nf H ρ :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: Xval_real_neg
decls.statement:
theorem Xval_real_neg (H : PWSetup Z g0 L M) (j : ℕ) {ρ : ℂ} (hρ : ρ ∈ tieSet Z g0 M) (hρim : ρ.im = 0) :
    Xval H j ρ = -(‖Xval H j ρ‖ : ℂ) :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: rep
decls.statement:
def rep (H : PWSetup Z g0 L M) (v : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  if h : ∃ ρ ∈ tieSet Z g0 M, vOf ρ = v then Classical.choose h else 0
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: rep_spec
decls.statement: theorem rep_spec (H : PWSetup Z g0 L M) {v : ℂ} (hv : v ∈ VF H) : rep H v ∈ tieSet Z g0 M ∧ vOf (rep H v) = v :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: XV
decls.statement: def XV (H : PWSetup Z g0 L M) (j : ℕ) (v : ℂ) : ℂ := Xval H j (rep H v)
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: XV_node
decls.statement: theorem XV_node (H : PWSetup Z g0 L M) (j : ℕ) {ρ : ℂ} (hρ : ρ ∈ tieSet Z g0 M) : XV H j (vOf ρ) = Xval H j ρ :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: XV_conj
decls.statement: theorem XV_conj (H : PWSetup Z g0 L M) (j : ℕ) {v : ℂ} (hv : v ∈ VF H) : XV H j (conj v) = conj (XV H j v) :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: sqrtC
decls.statement: def sqrtC (y : ℂ) : ℂ := Complex.exp (Complex.log y / 2)
decls.subject: ARITHMETIC-OR-LOGIC

decls.name: sqrtC_sq
decls.statement: theorem sqrtC_sq {y : ℂ} (hy : y ≠ 0) : sqrtC y ^ 2 = y :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: norm_sqrtC
decls.statement: theorem norm_sqrtC {y : ℂ} (hy : ‖y‖ = 1) : ‖sqrtC y‖ = 1 :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: Yv
decls.statement: def Yv (H : PWSetup Z g0 L M) (j : ℕ) (v : ℂ) : ℂ := -(conj (XV H j v)) / (‖XV H j v‖ : ℂ)
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: XV_ne
decls.statement: theorem XV_ne (H : PWSetup Z g0 L M) (j : ℕ) {v : ℂ} (hv : v ∈ VF H) : XV H j v ≠ 0 :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: norm_Yv
decls.statement: theorem norm_Yv (H : PWSetup Z g0 L M) (j : ℕ) {v : ℂ} (hv : v ∈ VF H) : ‖Yv H j v‖ = 1 :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: Yv_ne
decls.statement: theorem Yv_ne (H : PWSetup Z g0 L M) (j : ℕ) {v : ℂ} (hv : v ∈ VF H) : Yv H j v ≠ 0 :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: Yv_mul
decls.statement:
theorem Yv_mul (H : PWSetup Z g0 L M) (j : ℕ) {v : ℂ} (hv : v ∈ VF H) :

decls.name: poly_norm_le

decls.name: fixed_poly_bound

decls.name: coeffs_exist

      ∀ w : ℂ, ‖Polynomial.aeval w (Pof H Q)‖ ≤ B * (1 + ‖w‖) ^ D :=

decls.name: term_eq

decls.name: tie_term_neg

decls.name: Aw

decls.name: fR_norm_le

theorem fR_norm_le (H : PWSetup Zeta23.zetaZeroConfig g0 L M) (Q : ℕ → Polynomial ℝ) (B : ℝ) (D : ℕ)

      (Zeta23.zetaZeroConfig.mult x : ℝ) * (B ^ 2 * (1 + ‖wOf x‖) ^ (2 * D) * (offScore g0 x / M) ^ (2 ^ (j + 1))) :=

    (∀ τ : ℂ, F (2 + τ) = F τ) ∧

    (Not (Exists (fun n : Nat => (⟨sigma, t⟩ : ℂ) = -2 * (↑n + 1)))) /\

    (∀ i j, pairing i j = pairing j i) ∧
    (∀ i, 0 < pairing i i) ∧
    (∀ i j, pairing i i * T i j = pairing j j * T j i) ∧
    (∀ n, T n n = spectrum n) ∧
    (∀ σ : ℝ, is_xi_zero σ → ∃ n : ℕ, spectrum n = σ)

theorem rectangleIntegral'_mul_logDeriv_of_poles {f g : ℂ → ℂ} {z w : ℂ} (hre : z.re ≤ w.re)
    (him : z.im ≤ w.im) (Z P : Finset ℂ) (hZP : Disjoint Z P)
    (hPint : ∀ p ∈ P, Rectangle z w ∈ 𝓝 p)
    (hf : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ f (Rectangle z w \ (P : Set ℂ)))
    (hg : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g (Rectangle z w))
    (hborder : ∀ s ∈ RectangleBorder z w, f s ≠ 0)
    (hZ : ∀ s ∈ Rectangle z w \ (P : Set ℂ), f s = 0 ↔ s ∈ Z) (hZsub : (Z : Set ℂ) ⊆ Rectangle z w)
    (m : ℂ → ℕ)
    (hpole : ∀ p ∈ P, ∃ c : ℂ, c ≠ 0 ∧ Tendsto (fun s => (s - p) ^ m p * f s) (𝓝[≠] p) (𝓝 c)) :
    RectangleIntegral' (fun s => g s * logDeriv f s) z w
      = ∑ ρ ∈ Z, (analyticOrderNatAt f ρ : ℂ) * g ρ - ∑ p ∈ P, (m p : ℂ) * g p :=

    (Z : Finset ℂ) (hZ : ∀ s ∈ Rectangle z w, f s = 0 ↔ s ∈ Z) (hZsub : (Z : Set ℂ) ⊆ Rectangle z w) :
    RectangleIntegral' (fun s => g s * logDeriv f s) z w
      = ∑ ρ ∈ Z, (analyticOrderNatAt f ρ : ℂ) * g ρ :=

    (hf : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ f (Rectangle z w)) (hg : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g (Rectangle z w))
    (hborder : ∀ s ∈ RectangleBorder z w, f s ≠ 0) :
    RectangleIntegral' (fun s => g s * logDeriv f s) z w

          (hborder z (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨left_mem_uIcc, rfl⟩))))).toFinset,

decls.name: BlockInputs
decls.statement:
structure BlockInputs : Prop where
  /-- prop:block(ii) in hat units + "`N_on(I′) + 2p ≤ N(I′)`" -/
  hat : ∃ (Pm Qm : Matrix (Fin (P.d T)) (Fin (P.d T)) ℂ) (p : ℕ)
      (_ : Pm.PosSemidef) (hQm : Qm.IsHermitian),
      P.hat T (Z.Az P T) = Pm + Qm ∧ Pm.rank ≤ Z.s1 T + Z.s2 T ∧
      rtrace Pm ≤ (Z.NonIprime T : ℝ) ∧ posIndex hQm ≤ p ∧
      (Z.NonIprime T : ℝ) + 2 * p ≤ Z.NIprime T
  /-- prop:block(i) in tilde units + "`N(I′) ≥ s₁ + 2s₂ + 2p`" [eq:Ncount] -/
  tilde : ∃ (p : ℕ) (hAt : (P.tilde T (Z.Az P T)).IsHermitian),
      posIndex hAt ≤ Z.s1 T + Z.s2 T + p ∧ (P.tilde T (Z.Az P T)).rank ≤ (Z.ZIprime T).ncard ∧
      (Z.s1 T : ℝ) + 2 * Z.s2 T + 2 * p ≤ Z.NIprime T
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: TailInputs
decls.statement:
structure TailInputs (θ₀ : ℝ) : Prop where
  theta_nonneg : 0 ≤ θ₀
  /-- lem:weyl's hypothesis: every eigenvalue of `Ẽ` is at most `θ₀` in absolute value
  (this is `‖Ẽ‖ ≤ θ₀` for the operator norm of a Hermitian matrix) -/
  tilde : ∃ hEt : (P.tilde T (Z.Ez P T)).IsHermitian, ∀ i, |hEt.eigenvalues i| ≤ θ₀
  /-- `|tr Ê| ≤ ‖Ê‖₁`, `‖Ê‖_F ≤ ‖Ê‖₁`, `‖Ê‖₁ ≤ θ₀/(aL)` -/
  hat : ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ |rtrace (P.hat T (Z.Ez P T))| ≤ B ∧
      frobSq (P.hat T (Z.Ez P T)) ≤ B ^ 2 ∧ B ≤ θ₀ / (P.a T * P.L T)
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

  reflect_mem : ∀ ρ ∈ carrier, reflect ρ ∈ carrier
  mult_reflect : ∀ ρ ∈ carrier, mult (reflect ρ) = mult ρ
  /-- local finiteness in the ordinate: finitely many zeros with T₁ < γ ≤ T₂ -/

noncomputable def RectangleIntegral (f : ℂ → E) (z w : ℂ) : E :=
    HIntegral f z.re w.re z.im - HIntegral f z.re w.re w.im +
    VIntegral f w.re z.im w.im - VIntegral f z.re z.im w.im
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: UpperUIntegral
decls.statement:
noncomputable def UpperUIntegral (f : ℂ → E) (σ σ' T : ℝ) : E :=
    HIntegral f σ σ' T +
    I • (∫ y : ℝ in Ici T, f (σ' + y * I)) -
    I • (∫ y : ℝ in Ici T, f (σ + y * I))
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: LowerUIntegral
decls.statement:
noncomputable def LowerUIntegral (f : ℂ → E) (σ σ' T : ℝ) : E :=
    HIntegral f σ σ' (-T) -
    I • (∫ y : ℝ in Iic (-T), f (σ' + y * I)) +
    I • (∫ y : ℝ in Iic (-T), f (σ + y * I))
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: VerticalIntegral

noncomputable def VerticalIntegral (f : ℂ → E) (σ : ℝ) : E :=
    I • ∫ t : ℝ, f (σ + t * I)

lemma verticalIntegral_split_three (a b : ℝ)
    (hf : Integrable (fun t : ℝ ↦ f (σ + t * I))) :
    VerticalIntegral f σ =
      I • (∫ t in Iic a, f (σ + t * I)) + VIntegral f σ a b +
      I • ∫ t in Ici b, f (σ + t * I) :=

decls.name: DiffVertRect_eq_UpperLowerUs
decls.statement:
lemma DiffVertRect_eq_UpperLowerUs {σ σ' T : ℝ}
    (f_int_σ : Integrable (fun (t : ℝ) ↦ f (σ + t * I)))
    (f_int_σ' : Integrable (fun (t : ℝ) ↦ f (σ' + t * I))) :
    VerticalIntegral f σ' - VerticalIntegral f σ -
      RectangleIntegral f (σ - I * T) (σ' + I * T) =
    UpperUIntegral f σ σ' T - LowerUIntegral f σ σ' T :=

decls.name: ZeroFactor
decls.statement:
noncomputable def ZeroFactor (f : ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  if h1 : AnalyticAt ℂ f z then
    if h2 : analyticOrderAt f z ≠ ⊤ then
      (h1.analyticOrderAt_ne_top.mp h2).choose z
    else 0
  else 0

decls.name: ZeroFactorization
decls.statement:
lemma ZeroFactorization {R : ℝ} {f : ℂ → ℂ} {ρ : ℂ}
    (RleOne : R < 1)
    (hfAnalytic : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ f (Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1))
    (hf_neq_zero_at_zero : f 0 ≠ 0)
    (hρ : ρ ∈ SetOfZeros R f) :
    ∃ h_ρ : ℂ → ℂ, AnalyticAt ℂ h_ρ ρ ∧ h_ρ ρ ≠ 0 ∧ ZeroFactor f ρ = h_ρ ρ ∧
      f =ᶠ[nhds ρ] fun z ↦ (z - ρ) ^ analyticOrderNatAt f ρ * h_ρ z :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: Cf
decls.statement:
noncomputable def Cf (r : ℝ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  if finite_zeros_mono : (SetOfZeros r f).Finite then
    if _ : z ∈ SetOfZeros r f then
      ZeroFactor f z / ∏ ρ ∈ (finite_zeros_mono.toFinset \ {z}), (z - ρ) ^ (analyticOrderNatAt f ρ)
    else
      f z / ∏ ρ ∈ (finite_zeros_mono.toFinset), (z - ρ) ^ (analyticOrderNatAt f ρ)
  else 1

decls.name: expandAdditiveCombo
decls.statement:
partial def expandAdditiveCombo (ty : Expr) (stx : Syntax.Term) : TermElabM Expanded := withRef stx do
  match stx with
  | `(($e)) => expandLinearCombo ty e
  | `($e₁ + $e₂) => do
    match ← expandAdditiveCombo ty e₁, ← expandAdditiveCombo ty e₂ with
    | .const c₁, .const c₂ => .const <$> ``($c₁ + $c₂)
    | .proof p₁, .const c₂ => .proof <$> ``(pf_add_c $p₁ $c₂)
    | .const c₁, .proof p₂ => .proof <$> ``(c_add_pf $p₂ $c₁)
    | .proof p₁, .proof p₂ => .proof <$> ``(add_pf $p₁ $p₂)
  | `($e₁ - $e₂) => do
    match ← expandAdditiveCombo ty e₁, ← expandAdditiveCombo ty e₂ with
    | .const c₁, .const c₂ => .const <$> ``($c₁ - $c₂)
    | .proof p₁, .const c₂ => .proof <$> ``(pf_sub_c $p₁ $c₂)
    | .const c₁, .proof p₂ => .proof <$> ``(c_sub_pf $p₂ $c₁)
    | .proof p₁, .proof p₂ => .proof <$> ``(sub_pf $p₁ $p₂)
  | `(-$e) => do
    match ← expandAdditiveCombo ty e with
    | .const c => .const <$> `(-$c)
    | .proof p => .proof <$> ``(neg_pf $p)
  | `(← $e:term) => do
    match ← expandAdditiveCombo ty e with
    | .const c => return .const c
    | .proof p => .proof <$> ``(Eq.symm $p)
  | `($e₁ • $e₂) => do
    match ← expandAdditiveCombo ty e₁, ← expandAdditiveCombo ty e₂ with
    | .const c₁, .const c₂ => .const <$> ``($c₁ • $c₂)
    | .proof p₁, .const c₂ => .proof <$> ``(pf_smul_c $p₁ $c₂)
    | .const c₁, .proof p₂ => .proof <$> ``(c_smul_pf $p₂ $c₁)
    | .proof p₁, .proof p₂ => .proof <$> ``(smul_pf $p₁ $p₂)
  | e =>
    -- We have the expected type from the goal, so we can fully synthesize this leaf node.
    withSynthesize do
      -- It is OK to use `ty` as the expected type even if `e` is a proof.
      -- The expected type is just a hint.
      let c ← withSynthesizeLight <| Term.elabTerm e ty
      if (← whnfR (← inferType c)).isEq then
        .proof <$> c.toSyntax
      else
        .const <$> c.toSyntax
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: elabAdditiveCombination
decls.statement:
def elabAdditiveCombination (tk : Syntax)
    (norm? : Option Syntax.Tactic) (exp? : Option Syntax.NumLit) (input : Option Syntax.Term)
    (twoGoals := false) : Tactic.TacticM Unit := Tactic.withMainContext do
  let some (ty, _) := (← (← Tactic.getMainGoal).getType').eq? |
    throwError "'additive_combination' only proves equalities"
  let p ← match input with
  | none => `(Eq.refl 0)
  | some e =>
    match ← expandAdditiveCombo ty e with
    | .const c => `(Eq.refl $c)
    | .proof p => pure p
  let norm := norm?.getD (Unhygienic.run <| withRef tk `(tactic| ((try simp only [smul_add, smul_sub]); abel)))
  Term.withoutErrToSorry <| Tactic.evalTactic <| ← withFreshMacroScope <|
  if twoGoals then
    `(tactic| (
      refine eq_trans₃ $p ?a ?b
      case' a => $norm:tactic
      case' b => $norm:tactic))
  else
    match exp? with
    | some n =>
      if n.getNat = 1 then `(tactic| (refine eq_of_add $p ?a; case' a => $norm:tactic))
      else `(tactic| (refine eq_of_add_pow $n $p ?a; case' a => $norm:tactic))
    | _ => `(tactic| (refine eq_of_add $p ?a; case' a => $norm:tactic))
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: ExplicitFormulaPaper
decls.statement:
def ExplicitFormulaPaper (Z : ZeroConfig) : Prop :=
  ∀ (L : ℝ), 0 < L → ∀ (f g : ℝ → ℂ), ContDiff ℝ 2 f → ContDiff ℝ 2 g →
    tsupport f ⊆ Icc (-(L / 2)) (L / 2) → tsupport g ⊆ Icc (-(L / 2)) (L / 2) →
    Summable (fun ρ : Z.carrier => Z.Wsummand f g ρ) ∧
    Integrable (fun τ : ℝ => paperFT f τ * conj (paperFT g τ) * (nuX (Real.exp L) τ : ℂ)) ∧
    Z.W f g = ∫ τ : ℝ, paperFT f τ * conj (paperFT g τ) * (nuX (Real.exp L) τ : ℂ)
decls.subject: ZETA

structure RiemannVonMangoldt (Z : ZeroConfig) : Prop where
  main : ∃ C T₀ : ℝ, ∀ T : ℝ, T₀ ≤ T →
    |(Z.N T (2 * T) : ℝ) - T / (2 * Real.pi) * ell1 T| ≤ C * Real.log T
  local_count : ∃ A₀ : ℝ, 1 ≤ A₀ ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, (Z.N t (t + 1) : ℝ) ≤ A₀ * Real.log (|t| + 3)
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: ChebyshevMertens
decls.statement:
structure ChebyshevMertens : Prop where
  cheb1a : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x → ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊, Λ n ≤ C * x
  cheb1b : ∃ x₀ : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, x₀ ≤ x →
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊, Λ n / Real.sqrt n ≤ 3 * Real.sqrt x
  cheb1c : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x →
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊, Λ n / (Real.sqrt n * Real.log n) ≤ C * Real.sqrt x / Real.log x
  cheb1d : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x → ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊, Λ n ^ 2 ≤ C * x * Real.log x
  cheb2a : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x →
    |∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊, Λ n ^ 2 / n - Real.log x ^ 2 / 2| ≤ C * Real.log x
  cheb2b : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x →
    |∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊, Λ n ^ 2 / n * (Real.log x - Real.log n) - Real.log x ^ 3 / 6|
      ≤ C * Real.log x ^ 2
decls.subject: ARITHMETIC-OR-LOGIC

decls.name: MVHilbert
decls.statement:
def MVHilbert (C : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (freq δ : ι → ℝ) (x z : ι → ℂ),
    Function.Injective freq → (∀ r, 0 < δ r) → (∀ r s, r ≠ s → δ r ≤ |freq r - freq s|) →
    ‖∑ r, ∑ s, if r = s then (0 : ℂ) else x r * conj (z s) / ((freq r - freq s : ℝ) : ℂ)‖
      ≤ C * Real.sqrt (∑ r, ‖x r‖ ^ 2 / δ r) * Real.sqrt (∑ r, ‖z r‖ ^ 2 / δ r)
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: GammaFacts
decls.statement:
structure GammaFacts : Prop where
  even : ∀ τ : ℝ, mu (-τ) = mu τ
  smooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ mu
  monotoneOn : MonotoneOn mu (Ici 0)
  mu_zero_le : ∀ τ : ℝ, mu 0 ≤ mu τ
  neg_one_lt_mu_zero : -1 < mu 0
  stirling : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ τ : ℝ, 1 ≤ |τ| →
    |mu τ - (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) * Real.log (|τ| / (2 * Real.pi))| ≤ C / τ ^ 2
  deriv_bound : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ τ : ℝ, 1 ≤ |τ| → |deriv mu τ| ≤ C / |τ|
  int_mu : ∃ C T₀ : ℝ, ∀ T : ℝ, T₀ ≤ T →
    |(∫ τ in T..(2 * T), mu τ) - T * ell1 T / (2 * Real.pi)| ≤ C / T
  int_mu_sq : ∃ C T₀ : ℝ, ∀ T : ℝ, T₀ ≤ T →
    |(∫ τ in T..(2 * T), mu τ ^ 2) - T * ell1 T ^ 2 / (4 * Real.pi ^ 2)|
      ≤ C * (T * ell1 T ^ 2 / (4 * Real.pi ^ 2)) / l T ^ 2
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: PaperInputs
decls.statement:
structure PaperInputs (Z : ZeroConfig) : Prop where
  /-- H-EF  [prop:EF]/[eq:EF] -/
  EF : ExplicitFormulaPaper Z
  /-- H-RvM [eq:RvM] + local count [prop:tail] -/

decls.name: ZetaSeam
decls.statement:
structure ZetaSeam : Prop where
  /-- H-fin: at a nontrivial zero the analytic order is finite and ≥ 1. -/
  one_le_mult : ∀ ρ, IsNontrivialZero ρ → 1 ≤ zeroMult ρ
  /-- H-symm (set): ρ ↦ 1 − conj ρ preserves nontrivial zeros. -/
  reflect_zero : ∀ ρ, IsNontrivialZero ρ → IsNontrivialZero (reflect ρ)
  /-- H-symm (multiplicity). -/
  mult_reflect : ∀ ρ, IsNontrivialZero ρ → zeroMult (reflect ρ) = zeroMult ρ
  /-- local finiteness: finitely many nontrivial zeros with T₁ < γ ≤ T₂. -/
  finite_window : ∀ T₁ T₂ : ℝ, ({ρ | IsNontrivialZero ρ} ∩ {ρ | T₁ < ρ.im ∧ ρ.im ≤ T₂}).Finite
decls.subject: ZETA

decls.name: zetaZeros

def zetaZeros (hs : ZetaSeam) : ZeroConfig where
  carrier := {ρ | IsNontrivialZero ρ}
  mult := zeroMult
  one_le_mult := hs.one_le_mult
  strip := fun _ h => ⟨h.2.1.le, h.2.2.le⟩
  reflect_mem := hs.reflect_zero
  mult_reflect := hs.mult_reflect
  finite_window := hs.finite_window

      3 ↦ interface. -/
  MechClass : Fin 4 → Type
  /-- Generalized identity elements at each formation stage. -/
  IdentElem : Fin 4 → Type

  /-- Lemma 4.1: every identity element comes from some mechanism class

  noOrphans : (stage : Fin 4) → Surjective (identityOf stage)

    -- The diagonal's image is NOT detected
    (¬ obs.detected (coup.toCoupling.map diagonalConfig)) ∧
    -- Each paired element's image IS detected
    obs.detected (coup.toCoupling.map ⟨e1, by decide⟩) ∧
    obs.detected (coup.toCoupling.map ⟨e2, by decide⟩) ∧
    obs.detected (coup.toCoupling.map ⟨e3, by decide⟩) ∧
    obs.detected (coup.toCoupling.map ⟨f1, by decide⟩) ∧
    obs.detected (coup.toCoupling.map ⟨f2, by decide⟩) ∧
    obs.detected (coup.toCoupling.map ⟨f3, by decide⟩) :=

decls.name: Coupling

  map : A.Config → B.Config

      A.generates p c → ∃ (p' : B.Primitive), B.generates p' (map c)

decls.name: FaithfulCoupling

  primitive_reflecting :
    ∀ (c : A.Config) (p' : B.Primitive),
      B.generates p' (toCoupling.map c) → ∃ p : A.Primitive, A.generates p c

decls.name: Line

structure Line (P : Type) where
  a : P
  b : P
  c : P

decls.name: Line.Proper
decls.statement:
def Line.Proper {P : Type} (L : Line P) : Prop :=
  L.a ≠ L.b ∧ L.a ≠ L.c ∧ L.b ≠ L.c
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: DealignedAt
decls.statement:
def DealignedAt {P D : Type} (d : P → D) (L : Line P) : Prop :=
  d L.a ≠ d L.b ∧ d L.a ≠ d L.c ∧ d L.b ≠ d L.c
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: Dealigned
decls.statement:
def Dealigned {P D : Type} {n : Nat} (d : P → D) (lines : Fin n → Line P) : Prop :=
  ∀ i, DealignedAt d (lines i)
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: domainFault
decls.statement:
def domainFault {P D : Type} (d : P → D) (k : D) (p : P) : Prop :=
  d p = k
decls.subject: ARITHMETIC-OR-LOGIC

decls.name: CompletesLine
decls.statement:
def CompletesLine {P : Type} (F : P → Prop) (L : Line P) : Prop :=
  F L.a ∧ F L.b ∧ F L.c
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: no_domain_covers_line
decls.statement:
theorem no_domain_covers_line {P D : Type} (d : P → D) (L : Line P)

    ¬ CompletesLine (domainFault d k) L :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

    ∀ i, ¬ CompletesLine (domainFault d k) (lines i) :=
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: dealigned_of_lines_injective
decls.statement:
theorem dealigned_of_lines_injective {P D : Type} (d : P → D) (L : Line P)

    DealignedAt d L :=

decls.name: fanoLines
decls.statement:
def fanoLines : Fin 7 → Line (Fin 7) := fun i =>
  { a := i
  , b := ⟨(i.val + 1) % 7, Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)⟩
  , c := ⟨(i.val + 3) % 7, Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)⟩ }
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: dealignedCheck
decls.statement:
def dealignedCheck (d : Fin 7 → Fin 7) : Bool :=
  decide (∀ i : Fin 7,
    d (fanoLines i).a ≠ d (fanoLines i).b ∧
    d (fanoLines i).a ≠ d (fanoLines i).c ∧
    d (fanoLines i).b ≠ d (fanoLines i).c)
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE
